name: Dependency upgrade
description: Upgrade one dependency as a bounded compatibility exercise with advisory, licensing, lockfile, and runtime evidence.

outcomes.description: The requested dependency delta and transitive impact are documented with a compatibility decision.
Lockfile, build, and relevant runtime checks pass or the upgrade is safely abandoned.

prerequisites.description: The supported runtime range, reason for the update, and release notes are available.
prerequisites.check: Read the package changelog and identify breaking or security changes.

prerequisites.description: The current dependency state has a reproducible install and relevant test baseline.
prerequisites.check: Record safe version and test facts without copying registry credentials.

lanes.objective: Review advisories, license notes, release changes, and compatibility risk.
Apply the single dependency and lockfile change inside the reserved scope.
Run install, build, focused tests, and relevant compatibility checks.

qualityGates.description: Advisory, license, release-note, and transitive compatibility risks have a recorded disposition.
The lockfile and dependency manifest describe the same intentional delta.
Relevant build and test checks pass without hiding unsupported runtime behavior.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response for a package source.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; use an approved environment without recording secret material.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Change billing, account security, destructive data, or live financial behavior while updating a dependency.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Dependency changes should be verified offline or in a safe preview.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Restore the previously reviewed dependency state through a deliberate inverse change if compatibility or supply-chain evidence fails.
rescueSteps: Capture version, advisory, and check summaries without credentials.
Keep manifest and lockfile changes isolated.
Record the failing runtime or license condition and abandon safely.
stopConditions: The package source or release cannot be verified.
A breaking change lacks a migration path.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit registry credentials, tokens, private paths, and personal data.
Record package names and versions without secret configuration.
